what: One root text for a proc macro's lib and its lib test: when one job builds both (blaze test of a proc-macro package), the shared root is on disk + the proc-macro list + the #[cfg(test)] harness, so both build as under the pinned nightly. Until then Lowered::append_roots refuses naming both. One self-run request of its own, after the proc-macro list fix's result.

history.note: Resolved two ways: a harnessed test has its own alias root (01468, blaze-lower lib.rs), and with 01362 a proc macro lib appends nothing, so its lib and lib test never share a root text. identity_of hashes the root file content too (IDENTITY domain 3), so the harness is in the test identity and record key.
